model.title: Wintergreen Emergency Egress Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Timothy Kaine (D-VA)

summary.text: The bill would require the Secretary of the Interior to grant a right-of-way allowing for an emergency exit route across National Park Service land in Virginia. It aims to provide egress access for what appears to be a specific property or area in the state.
